transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. To start, can you tell me what's been bothering you or what brought you in to see me today?

I guess… I just can’t make myself do anything anymore. I mostly sit in my room, wearing the same clothes, and I don’t really do the things I used to, like knitting or journaling or going for walks. When my mom asks what’s wrong, I barely have the energy to answer her.
How long have you been feeling this way—days, weeks, or longer?
It’s been longer than weeks. I think it really started when I began the community college program… about two years and two months ago. It’s just been this slow decline since then.

Since this started about two years ago, has your mood been pretty much the same low level the whole time, or have there been stretches—weeks or months—where you felt back to your normal self before things got bad again?
No, not really. It hasn’t gone back to normal for weeks or months. It’s been more like one long decline since I started community college, about two years and a couple months ago.
During this time, have you experienced anything like hearing voices or sounds that others don't hear, or having thoughts or beliefs that others have told you seem unusual or untrue?

I don’t really hear voices, no. But… since I was in those college classes, I’ve felt like the school portal and the people in the clinic practicum were using little changes in wording, like in emails or assignment comments, to mark me somehow. Like they were showing I’m someone they don’t want in healthcare. My mom says they’re just normal messages, but it doesn’t feel that way to me.

Since these beliefs about being marked by the school started, has your low mood and loss of energy been present the whole time as well, or have there been periods where you still believed you were being marked but didn't feel as down or low in mood?

Mostly it’s been there the whole time. I just… I can’t make myself do things anymore. I sit in my room in the same clothes, and I don’t knit or journal or go walking like I used to. Even when my mom asks what’s wrong, I barely have the energy to answer her.

Has there ever been a period of at least two weeks where you still believed the school or clinic staff were marking you, but your mood and energy felt essentially normal, without the low mood or lack of motivation?

I don’t think so. Even when I was really sure the portal or the clinic people were marking me with those little wording changes, I wasn’t feeling normal. I still felt low and like I couldn’t get myself moving.

No, I don’t think there was a time like that. The whole time I was thinking the portal and the clinic people were using little wording changes to mark me, like in emails or comments. My mom kept saying they were just normal messages, but it still felt like they were showing I wasn’t wanted in healthcare.
